description: This file defines the DataGroupPermission entity class within the OrangeHRM project. It maps to the 'ohrm_user_role_data_group' database table and includes properties and methods related to managing permissions (read, create, update, delete, self) associated with data groups for specific user roles.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing permissions for user roles on data groups, including boolean flags for read, create, update, delete, and self permissions, with mappings to the database using Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the permission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the permission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Checks if create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Checks if update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Checks if delete permission is granted.

methods.name: isSelf
methods.description: Checks if self permission is granted.
